hero.title: Handmade Order Policy
hero.description: Every nail set is handmade based on the information provided by the customer. Please review your order carefully before checkout.

policyItems.title: No Refunds
policyItems.desc: Orders cannot be refunded after purchase

policyItems.title: Need Help?
policyItems.desc: Contact us via website chat support

items.1: We do not support refunds, returns, cancellations, or product exchanges after an order has been placed.
items.2: Please carefully review your order details and measure your nail sizes correctly before purchasing to ensure the best fit.
items.3: The shop is not responsible for incorrect sizes selected by the customer.
items.4: All products are handmade according to the exact information provided in the order.
items.5: If you need assistance or have any questions, please contact us through the live chat button on our website.

notes.title: Important Notes
items: All nail sets are handmade and made-to-order.
Please measure your nails carefully before ordering.
Colors may appear slightly different depending on screen settings.
Processing and shipping times may vary by region.

cta.title: Need Assistance?
cta.description: If you have questions before placing your order, feel free to contact us through the website chat support.
